scope: read-only review of OpenVerified ordering, cleanup quarantine, one-shot Registry wrapper, and loopback request guards

findings.title: OpenVerified file identity is not explicitly bound to the SQLite file object later used
findings.recommendation: Specify atomic verified open and pass the same handle/object to SQLite, or a fully equivalent nonreplaceable open protocol; prohibit path reopen after validation and cover replacement injection.

findings.title: Cleanup quarantine catalog access and failure ordering are underspecified
findings.recommendation: Protect and identity-verify the catalog, consult it before case path creation/open, durably record quarantine before releasing lifecycle lock, and fail closed if catalog verification/write fails.

implementation_gates: Demonstrate the exact SQLite driver's verified-handle/no-follow open path on Windows and POSIX.
Implement pinned-connection rollback_proven without treating unknown commit as rollback.
